morning.arabic: أَصْبَحْنَا وَأَصْبَحَ الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
morning.transliteration: Asbahna wa asbaha'l-mulku lillah, alhamdu lillah la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu'l-mulku wa lahu'l-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
morning.translation: We have entered upon a morning and all the dominion belongs to Allah. Praise be to Allah, there is no deity except Allah alone without any partners, for Him is the dominion and for Him is all praise, and He is capable of all things

morning.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بِك أَصْبَحْنَا وَبِك أَمْسَيْنَا وَبِك نَحْيَا وَبِك نَمُوتُ وَإِلَيْك النُّشُورُ
morning.transliteration: Allahumma bika asbahna wa bika amsayna wa bika nahya wa bika namutu wa ilayka an-nushur
morning.translation: O Allah, by You we have entered the morning and by You we have entered the evening, by You we live and by You we die, and to You is the return
I seek refuge in Allah from the accursed Satan

morning.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
morning.translation: Glory be to Allah and in His praise, glory be to Allah the Mighty
Allah is sufficient for us and what an excellent Guardian He is

evening.arabic: أَمْسَيْنَا وَأَمْسَى الْمُلْكُ لِلَّهِ، الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ لا إِلَهَ إِلا اللَّهُ وَحْدَهُ لا شَرِيكَ لَهُ، لَهُ الْمُلْكُ وَلَهُ الْحَمْدُ وَهُوَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
evening.transliteration: Amsayna wa amsa'l-mulku lillah, alhamdu lillah la ilaha illallahu wahdahu la sharika lahu, lahu'l-mulku wa lahu'l-hamdu wa huwa 'ala kulli shay'in qadir
evening.translation: We have entered upon an evening and all the dominion belongs to Allah. Praise be to Allah, there is no deity except Allah alone without any partners, for Him is the dominion and for Him is all praise, and He is capable of all things

evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَسْلَمْتُ نَفْسِي إِلَيْك، وَفَوَّضْتُ أَمْرِي إِلَيْك، وَوَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِي إِلَيْك، وَأَلْجَأْتُ ظَهْرِي إِلَيْك، رَغْبَةً وَرَهْبَةً إِلَيْك، لا مَلْجَأَ وَلا مَنْجَا مِنْك إِلا إِلَيْك
evening.transliteration: Allahumma aslamt nafsi ilayk, wa fawwadt amri ilayk, wa wajjahtu wajhi ilayk, wa aljat zahri ilayk, raghbatan wa rahbatan ilayk, la maljaa wa la manjaa minka illa ilayk
evening.translation: O Allah, I have surrendered myself to You, entrusted my affairs to You, and turned my face toward You, and sought Your help relying on You. Out of hope in You and fear of You. There is no refuge nor escape from You except with You

evening.arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُك الْعَفْوَ وَالْعَافِيَةَ فِي الدُّنْيَا وَالْآخِرَةِ
evening.transliteration: Allahumma inni as'aluka'l-'afwa wa'l-'afiyah fi'd-dunya wa'l-akhirah
evening.translation: O Allah, I ask You for forgiveness and wellness in this life and the hereafter

evening.arabic: سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ وَبِحَمْدِهِ، سُبْحَانَ اللَّهِ الْعَظِيمِ
evening.translation: Glory be to Allah and in His praise, glory be to Allah the Mighty

evening.arabic: يَا حَيُّ يَا قَيُّومُ، بِرَحْمَتِك أَسْتَغِيثُ
evening.transliteration: Ya Hayy ya Qayyum, bi-rahmatika astagheeth
evening.translation: O Living One, O Self-Sustaining One, by Your mercy I seek help

items.arabic: الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ الَّذِي أَحْيَانَا بَعْدَ مَا أَمَاتَنَا وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشُورُ
items.transliteration: Alhamdu lillahi'lladhi ahyana baʿda ma amātanā wa ilayhi'n-nushūr
items.translation: Praise be to Allah who has given us life after death, and to Him is the return
O Allah, open for me the gates of Your mercy

items.arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ، اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيمَا رَزَقْتَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ النَّارِ
items.transliteration: Bismillah, Allahumma barik lana fima razaqtana wa qina adhab an-nar
items.translation: In the name of Allah. O Allah, bless for us what You have provided us with and protect us from the punishment of the Fire

items.arabic: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَٰذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَىٰ رَبِّنَا لَمُنقَلِبُونَ
items.transliteration: Subhana'lladhi sakhkhara lana hadha wa ma kunna lahu muqrinīn, wa inna ilā rabbinā lamunqalibūn
items.translation: Glory is to Him Who has subjugated this to us, and we ourselves would not have been capable of it, and surely to our Lord we will return

items.arabic: لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا أَنتَ سُبْحَانَك إِنِّي كُنتُ مِنَ الظَّالِمِينَ
items.transliteration: La ilaha illa anta subhanaka inni kuntu mina'z-zalimin
items.translation: There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers
